WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM attendance AS a
  JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
  JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
  GROUP BY z.city
),
city_shares AS (
  SELECT city, member_count,
         1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(member_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - overall.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM city_shares
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE share > overall.average_share
